content: Pants Pankuro (Japanese: パンツぱんくろう) is the title of a series of animated shorts, each lasting just over a minute, that are broadcast on Japanese public television. The series is specifically designed for toddlers and young children, with most episodes addressing topics related to toilet training. The show features anthropomorphic characters, such as talking toilets and washing machines, who provide guidance to children on how to use the restroom and how to handle situations involving accidents. The main character, Pants Pankuro, is a three-year-old boy who has recently started wearing underpants and using the toilet. His younger sister, Komingo, has not yet been toilet trained. Another character, Koricchi, is a boy of the same age as Pankuro, and the two share a highly competitive relationship. Koin, a girl of similar age, enjoys spinning and dancing. Toire-sama, Pankuro's friendly household toilet, is treated by Pankuro with great respect, almost as if he were an older relative. Kamiko-san is the toilet roll holder. Sentako Hacchan, an eight-legged washing machine, is another character who is very enthusiastic about doing laundry. The name Sentako Hacchan is derived from the Japanese words sentaku (laundry) and tako (octopus). Additionally, Koricchi's family owns an old-fashioned squat toilet, though its name is not mentioned.
